author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take another look at the cybersecurity disaster this year regarding PHP, one of the most used pieces of software running the Internet. Things keep escalating and in the 24 hours since disclosure you've got people already scouring the net for servers they can take over. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: It Just Keep Getting More Insane...
